text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Candidates in the parliamentary election accuse the authorities of biase towards the National Democratic Rally (RND), grouping President Liamine Zeroual's supporters. RND says the allegations are baseless.
- "Terrorists" kill a family of three members in Sidi Moussa, south of Algiers.
- About 25 countries will send 90 officials to supervise the Algerian parliamentary elections under the United Nations authority.
- Zeroual, presiding over the last meeting of the government-appointed Transitional National Council, vows to respect the results of the upcoming voting to elect the 380-seat National Assembly.
- Foreign observers to set up four offices in Constantine, Oran, Algiers and Ghardaia to oversee the June 5 Algerian poll.
